# AI Concepts Ingested From Shared Visual

Source context: user-shared social post image (ByteByteGo visual).
Purpose: make these concepts queryable by the multi-agent retrieval system.

## Concepts captured

- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
- RLHF and RLVR (reinforcement learning feedback/verification style loops)
- VAE (Variational Autoencoder)
- Multi-step Agents (orchestrator + tools + memory + action loop)
- Few-shot Prompting
- Collaborative Filtering
- Tokenization
- Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting

## Operational usage in this workspace

- Retrieval and semantic grounding: RAG
- Agent orchestration pattern: Multi-step Agents
- Memory and state continuity: persistent knowledge + reports
- Verification loops: checker/gate patterns aligned with RL-style feedback ideas

## Tag vocabulary for search

rag, retrieval, lora, rlhf, rlvr, vae, multi-step agents, orchestrator, few-shot, collaborative filtering, tokenization, chain of thought, cot
